whatThisIs: Transaction-level campaign-finance records ACTUALLY RETRIEVED from the Pima County filing officer's own portal API, anonymously. This is the acquisition that az-pima-2026-held.json recorded as blocked by HTTP 401 on the filing-body route. The 401 was one route; this is a different representation of the same records, and it carries amounts and dates.

acquisition.permissionEvidence: https://ecf-api.easyvoteapp.com/robots.txt answers HTTP 404 with no robots document, so the host publishes no restriction (NO_ROBOTS), re-read 2026-08-29. The tenant host https://pimacountyaz.easyvotecampaignfinance.com/robots.txt answers HTTP 200 but serves the Angular index.html, which is not a robots document.
acquisition.authentication: NONE SENT AND NONE REQUIRED. The API's own CurrentUserOrWebSiteUserAsync path falls back to a per-tenant anonymous website user; it needs only the tenant subdomain, which it reads from the Origin header the county's own public web app sends. No credential, no login, no bypass.
acquisition.discoveredVia: The 59 API routes reachable from the tenant SPA bundle main.b280bfb8ae2b4a7a.js were enumerated by extracting every API_BASE_URL(...) concatenation. advancedsearch/contributions and advancedsearch/distributions were among them; the filing-body route was not the only one.
acquisition.whyThePriorWalkGot401: documents/getdocumentfiling/{id} answers 401 with a 58-byte IIS edge page both with and without a trailing slash. That route is genuinely closed to an anonymous caller. It is a fact about that route and never about the records, which this route returns.

reconciliation.question: Is the unfiltered row count a complete result or a silent server-side cap?
reconciliation.method: The same endpoint was called with minDate/maxDate bounding each year, and the server's row count compared against the count of that year already present in the committed unfiltered result. A capped result cannot partition consistently.
reconciliation.verdict: NOT A CAP. The committed row count is the endpoint's complete result for this customer id.

limitsOfThisUniverse: EVERY filing behind these rows is a REDACTED public copy: all contribution rows carry a DocumentFilingId ending '_Redacted'. This is the county's published redacted version, not the unredacted filing.
EVERY row of both result sets carries DocumentType 'CCFR'. No other document type was returned by this endpoint.

NO INDEPENDENT-EXPENDITURE ROW. An Arizona independent-expenditure report is a different document type and this endpoint did not return one. That is a statement about this route, never a finding that no independent expenditure occurred.

NO COMMITTEE-TO-MEASURE LINKAGE. Neither this endpoint nor the state register publishes which committees support or oppose a ballot measure. A committee's NAME is not evidence of its position and this product never infers one.

DATES ARE AS FILED AND SOME ARE PLAINLY WRONG — years 0006 and 2926 appear, and some rows carry a null date. They are preserved exactly as the filer entered them and never repaired, because a corrected date would be our claim rather than the filer's record.

COMMITTEE NAMES ARE AS FILED AND NOT DEDUPLICATED. 'Andrés for Supervisor' and 'ANDRES FOR SUPERVISOR' both appear. They are not merged here: matching them would be a name match, which this project's own bar refuses to treat as agreement.

ItemizedListType IS NOT UNIFORM. A contribution result set also carries Loan, Interest, Rebate/Refund and Donation/Support rows; a distribution result set also carries Contributions Made, Reimbursements and Outstanding Accounts/Debts. Summing across them would invent a figure no filer reported.

stillOwed.record: Arizona INDEPENDENT-EXPENDITURE reports for Pima County committees
stillOwed.why: every row this route returns carries DocumentType 'CCFR'. The IE class is a different document type.
stillOwed.nextRoute: https://seethemoney.az.gov — AZ Secretary of State's campaign-finance reporting surface
stillOwed.permission: ALLOWED. robots.txt answers HTTP 404 (NO_ROBOTS), re-read 2026-08-29; no terms page. The landing page answers HTTP 200 and POST /Reporting/GetNEWTableData answers HTTP 200 JSON.
stillOwed.progressThisSession: docs/sources.md recorded this endpoint as 'REACHABLE, parameters NOT determined'. The parameter NAMES are now determined, read out of the site's own bundle /bundles/core: Page, startYear, endYear, JurisdictionId, TablePage, TableLength, TableSearch, Name, NameId, CommitteeId, BallotMeasureId, OfficeID, PartyID, IsLessActive, ShowAllYears, ShowOfficeHolder, ChartName, URLHash, CommitteeReportId, ExportOptions. The route is a DataTables serverSide POST to /Reporting/GetNEWTableData/{querystring}, and /Reporting/ExportEntityTransactions/{querystring}&ExportOptions= is a bulk export of the same data.
stillOwed.whatIsStillUnknown: the VALUE vocabulary. Every combination tried returned HTTP 200 with a 2-byte empty JSON string, so Page's numeric token set and the entity-selecting URLHash are not yet established. This is a route still being worked, and it is NEVER evidence that Arizona publishes no independent expenditures.
stillOwed.exactNextStep: Drive https://seethemoney.az.gov/Reporting/AdvancedSearch/ in a browser and observe the app's own POST body and URLHash for one known committee, exactly as the Pima Origin header was learned. The two prior rungs both fell to reading the app's own traffic rather than guessing.

stillOwed.why: every filing id held ends '_Redacted', and documents/getdocumentfiling/{id} answers HTTP 401 with a 58-byte IIS edge page, with and without a trailing slash.
stillOwed.nextRoute: a public-records request to the Pima County filing officer (Pima County Elections, Tucson AZ 85756)
stillOwed.permission: N/A — this is an offline custodian request, not a web route.
stillOwed.progressThisSession: the redaction was IDENTIFIED as a redaction rather than mistaken for the whole record.
stillOwed.exactNextStep: PUBLIC RECORD STILL OWED — HUMAN/OFFLINE ACCESS REQUIRED. File the records request; the obligation stays live.
